analysis:
MARKET & PORTFOLIO REVIEW (2026-08-24): SPY remains in a healthy uptrend (+1.9% vs SMA50, slope positive) so the macro backdrop supports selective long exposure. However, our own track record demands humility — profit factor 0.44x and Sortino -3.57 signal that prior stock-picks have destroyed value vs. buy-and-hold. The honest lesson: be fewer, better, and more patient.

EXISTING POSITIONS: AMP (+3.27%) and MCO (+6.83%) are performing well; theses intact, no action needed. IDXX (-0.29%) is essentially flat — veterinary diagnostics is a compounding business and a small loss in a choppy market is not thesis-break; hold. LMT (-2.78%) is the weak link. Defense spending tailwinds remain real (NATO budgets, US supplemental), but LMT underperforms peers and the broader market. It is not yet at stop, so no forced exit, but the position warrants close monitoring — if price fails to reclaim the $580 entry area within the next 4-6 weeks, or defense budget news deteriorates, close it. We already have 4 positions (at the lower bound of our 3-5 target), so adding one more quality name to 5 total is appropriate given $35.9k headroom.

NEW BUY RATIONALE: Stryker (SYK) is the single cleanest asymmetric setup on the screen: (1) Fundamental — premier medical-device compounder with 27% op margins, $4.1B FCF, 9.4% revenue growth, and a forward P/E of ~20x that is reasonable for the quality; surgical robotics (Mako) and implant volume recovery post-COVID create a multi-year growth runway. (2) Technical — at only +0.9% above SMA50 with a +4.2%/20d slope, SYK is just beginning a Stage 1→2 transition after a ~15% pullback from 52-week highs. At the 44th percentile of its 52-week range, it is not extended. This is exactly the Weinstein basing-to-breakout window the strategy targets. Earnings 66 days out give sufficient runway to establish the position without binary event risk at entry. One new position (SYK) brings the book to 5 — a full, disciplined slate. No further new buys are warranted this cycle; remaining cash serves as a buffer and optionality for thesis-break exits.

trades.entry_strategy: Limit order at $329.00 or better; acceptable to pay up to $332 if momentum accelerates past the SMA50. Prefer entry on a flat-to-slightly-down open day to improve fill.
trades.rationale: FUNDAMENTAL: Stryker is a best-in-class medical device compounder — Mako robotic surgery platform growing double-digits, diversified across ortho, neuro, and MedSurg, 27% operating margins, $4.1B FCF, conservative balance sheet (D/E 64). Forward P/E ~20x for a business with this quality and 9-10% organic growth is a fair price. Analyst revisions flat but not negative — no earnings-estimate deterioration risk. TECHNICAL: SYK is basing at the 44th percentile of its 52-week range after a ~15% correction from $390 highs. Price is only 0.9% above SMA50 with the 20-day SMA50 slope accelerating to +4.2% — classic early Stage 2 confirmation without being extended. ATR of 2.8% allows a clean 2x ATR stop at ~$18.50 below entry, keeping position risk at ~1.4% of equity. Risk/reward to prior highs near $385 is ~3:1.
trades.exit_plan: Primary stop: $310.50 (2x ATR below entry). Thesis-break conditions: (1) quarterly revenue growth decelerates below 6% or op margins compress meaningfully; (2) Mako placement data disappoints; (3) price closes two consecutive weeks below the 50-week SMA. Time stop: if SYK has not moved +8% or more within 10 weeks of entry, re-evaluate whether the setup was valid. Hold through earnings (Oct 29) if position is profitable and stop has not been touched — consider tightening stop to breakeven ahead of that date. Target $384 represents a return toward the 52-week high; if reached, take half off and trail remaining with a 10% trailing stop for potential LTCG qualification.
